title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Tuesday, 17 November 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission approves amended German State aid schemes for energy-intensive companies
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, Germany's amended schemes to compensate energy-intensive companies for indirect emission costs under the EU Emission Trading System (EU ETS) and for temporary electricity price relief under the Clean Industrial Deal State aid Framework (CISAF) and Middle East Crisis Temporary State Aid Framework (METSAF).

sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: Could the Airbus' €3 billion loan row reignite a US-EU trade dispute?
items.description: The US says a record €3 billion financing package for Airbus may conflict with a transatlantic aircraft-subsidy truce. EU officials insist the funding complies with market-based rules.

items.title: EU sanctions Wildberries CEO Tatyana Kim, Russia's richest woman
items.description: Wildberries, Russia's largest online retailer, has been the target of Ukrainian attacks for its role in supplying the Russian military. The EU has now frozen its owner's assets and banned her from travel to the bloc.
